python3 -c "
import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

rows = []
for row in root.iter('{%s}row' % M):
    cells = {}
    for c in row:
        ref = c.get('r')           # e.g. A1
        t = c.get('t')             # type: s=shared str, str=inline str, n=num
        v = c.find('{%s}v' % M)
        val = v.text if v is not None else None
        isel = c.find('{%s}is' % M)
        if isel is not None:
            val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in isel.iter('{%s}t' % M))
        cells[ref] = (t, val)
    rows.append(cells)

# Print all cells in grid order
for cells in rows:
    items = sorted(cells.items(), key=lambda kv: (int(re.search(r'\d+', kv[0]).group()), kv[0]))
    for ref, (t, val) in items:
        print(ref, repr(val))
" 2>&1 | head -100

python3 -c "
import zipfile, shutil

# 1) Backup original
shutil.copy('budget.xlsx', 'budget.backup.xlsx')

# 2) Parse expense rows (rows 11-22, column C) and verify against formula range
import re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

expenses = []
for row in root.iter('{%s}row' % M):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    if 11 <= r <= 22:
        for c in row:
            if c.get('r') == 'C%d' % r:
                v = c.find('{%s}v' % M)
                expenses.append(float(v.text))
print('Expense values (C11:C22):', expenses)
print('Count:', len(expenses), '| Sum:', sum(expenses))

# Per-category breakdown from column A
cats = {}
for row in root.iter('{%s}row' % M):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    if 11 <= r <= 22:
        a = b = c = None
        for cell in row:
            ref = cell.get('r')
            v = cell.find('{%s}v' % M)
            isel = cell.find('{%s}is' % M)
            val = None
            if isel is not None:
                val = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in isel.iter('{%s}t' % M))
            elif v is not None:
                val = v.text
            if ref == 'A%d' % r: a = val
            elif ref == 'C%d' % r: c = float(val)
        cats[a] = cats.get(a, 0) + c
print('Per category:')
for k, val in cats.items():
    print('  %-15s %s' % (k, val))
print('Category total:', sum(cats.values()))
"

python3 -c "
import zipfile, re, shutil

SRC = 'budget.xlsx'
xml = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC).read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')

old = '<c r=\"C23\" s=\"3\"><f>SUM(C11:C22)</f><v></v></c>'
new = '<c r=\"C23\" s=\"3\"><f>SUM(C11:C22)</f><v>4200</v></c>'
assert old in xml, 'target cell C23 not found as expected'
xml = xml.replace(old, new)

# Rebuild the xlsx with all original entries, only sheet1.xml changed
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
tmp = 'budget_new.xlsx'
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        data = xml.encode('utf-8')
    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close(); zin.close()
shutil.move(tmp, SRC)
print('Updated budget.xlsx with cached total in C23')
"
